pages.title: More Than Nine
pages.text: Learn a larger recipe surface; extra brass supports your own pattern.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Arrange crafters to match a real recipe and point their arrows toward the output. Retrieve the completed result.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Arrange powered Mechanical Crafters in the recipe shape and wrench their output arrows into one collection path. Automate a crafting recipe; use covers for empty slots or a redstone start when appropriate.
